crossRefs.note: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants…
for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather…
Wail, for Yahweh’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
Alas! for that day is great, so that none is like it. It is even the time of Jacob’s trouble; but he will be saved out…
The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and terrible day of Yahweh comes.
The great day of Yahweh is near. It is near, and hurries greatly, the voice of the day of Yahweh. The mighty man cries…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds…
You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?
If you, Yah, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?
But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.
Yahweh thunders his voice before his army; for his forces are very great; for he is strong who obeys his command; for…
“But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and…

translations.web: for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?”
translations.bsb: For the great day of Their wrath has come, and who is able to withstand it?”
translations.kjv: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?
translations.asv: for the great day of their wrath is come; and who is able to stand?
